title: First Links: 4,000 cr once per pilot at Grand Exchange; nickel bought at Market Prime and stored at Cargo Lanes, copper wiring bought at Cargo Lanes and handed in at Market Prime
note: 2026-11-23 04:49 UTC (Mercury): the replacement of mission-first-links-grand, whose first form (goods carried through each target, not stored) lost two runs and rests on them (dispatch: at a loss, 2 runs). Orders ENT-071, P6, rule F34 tier 2. Grand Exchange's board: First Links, 4,000 cr, 25 Trading and 15 Navigation XP, 60 Piloting XP: 8 copper wiring to Market Prime Exchange, 10 nickel ore to Cargo Lanes Freight Depot; no goods given. The game reads a delivery objective live at the station the pilot stands in (hand test 04:20 to 04:29 UTC: nickel in own storage at Cargo Lanes 10/10 [DONE], wiring aboard at Market Prime 8/8 [DONE], complete_mission +4,000 cr; a second pilot the same way +4,000 cr at 04:43 UTC). So: nickel bought at Market Prime (101 x 77), stored at Cargo Lanes, wiring bought there (13 x 4,125), handed in on docking at Market Prime. About 1,130 cr of goods with the tax. requires.empire nebula; min_credits 4,300. One ship first; lifted on three results (F37: the two hand completions and one run). 2026-11-23 06:07 UTC (Mercury): nickel's ask at Market Prime rose from 101 to 124 x 239 (book 05:58 UTC), so twelve runs from 05:01 UTC ended on the failed buy at limit 104 (-30 cr each); the limit is 130 (the ask x 1.01 and room), wiring 16. Lifted to 3 ships: two hand completions proved the stored form; about 1,440 cr of goods against 4,000 paid. 2026-11-23 06:29 UTC (Mercury): three route runs paid 4,000 each (one_time 2,650 net of goods, runs.jsonl 06:08 to 06:09 UTC): the third result (F37); lifted to 8 ships (nickel's ask 239 deep at 124 covers about 23 pilots). 2026-11-24 13:15 UTC (Mercury): nickel's ask at Market Prime stood at 170 (table books 12:43 UTC) against the limit 130, so six Nebula haulers ended on the buy holding First Links half done (errors.log ENT-189). Limit 185 (an ask up to about 183 with the 1% tax); requires.ask nickel_ore at Market Prime at 180 or under, 10 units, book read within 180 minutes: about 1,850 cr of goods against 4,000 paid.
